kSpace.renderer: Interactive browser Canvas2D aggregate topological-depth graph
kSpace.liveBoundary: Live means the browser redraws and interacts with the measured public projection. It does not mean live model inference, production database streaming, or a physical processor trace.
kSpace.layoutBoundary: Horizontal position is authentic topological depth and each anonymous point corresponds to one authentic ONNX operator. Vertical lanes and jitter are deterministic display layout; the Z axis is unused.
kSpace.disclosureBoundary: The public projection publishes aggregate block/depth/operator and edge counts. Exact node and tensor names, exact wiring, initializer identities and hashes, weights, vectors, and activations remain withheld.
kSpace.comparisonBoundary: No authentic architecture-matched zero checkpoint is available. Zero-versus-trained comparison, training-effect metrics, and Neural Persistence are not computed.
kSpace.computeBoundary: Operator counts and the compute convention are published, but a total MAC/FLOP figure is unavailable without complete per-node shape handling and verified MoE routing semantics.
unavailableClaims: Neural Persistence or delta Neural Persistence

operatingProof.name: NewsBoy
operatingProof.embeddedReaderBoundary: Read-only same-origin reader for the fixed NewsBoy coverage route. The Worker validates the current source page, fetches the fixed public edition-record API, and renders an accessible script-free view of the attributed titles, summaries, sections, dates, and source links. The preview does not scroll or receive focus; its primary action expands to a full viewport, and closing reloads the live record at the top and restores the original card position and focus. Incomplete upstream HTML or edition data fails visibly instead of serving a stale edition.
operatingProof.summary: Rights-aware Arabic daily news with public source citations, a navigable site archive and a live semantic LEAP and DeepFest edition reader.
